title: The role of inflammation in cadmium nephrotoxicity: NF-kappaB comes into view.
authors: Hassanein, Emad H M; Mohamed, Wafaa R; Ahmed, Osama S; Abdel-Daim, Mohamed M; Sayed, Ahmed M
one_liner_zh: 综述镉肾毒性中NF-kappaB介导的炎症机制及抑制剂作用，仅提及NF-kappaB为转录因子，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Kidney diseases are major health problem and understanding the underlined mechanisms that lead to kidney diseases are critical research points with a marked potential impact on health. Cadmium (Cd) is a heavy metal that occurs naturally and can be found in contaminated food. Kidneys are the most susceptible organ to heavy metal intoxication as it is the main route of waste excretion. The harmful effects of Cd were previously well proved. Cd induces inflammatory responses, oxidative injury, mitochondrial dysfunction and disturbs Ca(2+) homeostasis. The nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) is a cellular transcription factor that regulates inflammation and controls the expression of many inflammatory cytokines. Therefore, great therapeutic benefits can be attained from NF-kappaB inhibition. In this review we focused on certain compounds including cytochalasin D, mangiferin, N-acetylcysteine, pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate, roflumilast, rosmarinic acid, sildenafil, sinapic acid, telmisartan and wogonin and certain plants as Astragalus Polysaccharide, Ginkgo Biloba and Thymus serrulatus that potently inhibit NF-kappaB and effectively counteracted Cd-associated renal intoxication. In conclusion, the proposed NF-kappaB involvement in Cd-renal intoxication clarified the underlined inflammation associated with Cd-nephropathy and the beneficial effects of NF-kappaB inhibitors that make them the potential to substantially optimize treatment protocols for Cd-renal intoxication.
abstract_zh: 肾脏疾病是重大健康问题，理解导致肾脏疾病的潜在机制是至关重要的研究点，对健康具有显著潜在影响。镉（Cd）是一种天然存在的重金属，可在受污染的食物中发现。肾脏是对重金属中毒最易感的器官，因为它是废物排泄的主要途径。镉的有害效应此前已被充分证实。镉诱导炎症反应、氧化损伤、线粒体功能障碍，并扰乱Ca(2+)稳态。核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）是一种细胞转录因子，调节炎症并控制许多炎症细胞因子的表达。因此，抑制NF-kappaB可带来显著的治疗益处。在本综述中，我们聚焦于某些化合物，包括细胞松弛素D、芒果苷、N-乙酰半胱氨酸、吡咯烷二硫代氨基甲酸酯、罗氟司特、迷迭香酸、西地那非、芥子酸、替米沙坦和汉黄芩素，以及某些植物如黄芪多糖、银杏叶和百里香，这些物质能有效抑制NF-kappaB并有效对抗镉相关的肾脏中毒。总之，提出的NF-kappaB参与镉肾脏中毒的机制阐明了与镉肾病相关的潜在炎症，以及NF-kappaB抑制剂的 beneficial 效应，使其具有显著优化镉肾脏中毒治疗方案的潜力。
